stem: The heights of a certain species of deer are known to have standard deviation 0.35 m. A zoologist takes a random sample of 150 of these deer and finds that the mean height of the deer in the sample is 1.42 m.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate a 96% confidence interval for the population mean height.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Bubay says that 96% of deer of this species are likely to have heights that are within this confidence interval.

Explain briefly whether Bubay is correct.
